name: disable_selected_object_color_override

stack.evidence: ScriptCommand_DisableSelectedObjectColorOverride does not access the Script value stack; when a selected object exists, it calls func_0013DF48, which clears object flag 0x4000 and thereby disables the RGBA override consumed by the render path

notes: This is the zero-argument inverse of opcode 141 and occurs 333 times across the corpus.
